findings.title: 3 hidden wallet clusters
findings.detail: 29 top-holder wallets resolve to 3 linked groups holding 28.8% of supply. The largest (16 wallets) holds 20.1%.

findings.title: Linked wallets are selling
findings.detail: Clustered wallets moved out 2.5% of supply in the last 7 days.

findings.title: Supply is concentrated
findings.detail: The top 10 owners control 34.8% of supply once linked wallets are merged (it looks like 14.1% if you count wallets naively).

findings.title: Fresh wallets are driving demand
findings.detail: Brand-new wallets net bought $2,900,000 this week, far outpacing proven traders.

findings.title: Smart Money is accumulating
findings.detail: 9 Smart Money wallets hold 3.9% of supply, up 1.4% in 30 days.
